Nek'zali the Soulcoiler: [해제] Once the Essence Rend target reaches the edge of the room, dispel it with Purify Spirit. A Latent Cultist pool is left where it was removed.
[생존기] Soulcoil Rite goes off with every Phase 2 Invoke, so take a turn with Healing Tide Totem.
@m [차단] If you are on the well-kill team, interrupt Drowned Echo's Soulcoiler's Curse with Wind Shear.

Entombed Sentinels: [해제] Blighted Blood is a Magic effect, so dispel it right away with Purify Spirit.
[분담] When the whole group soaks Unstable Miasma within 7.5 yards, drop Spirit Link Totem on that spot to even out health.
[위치] The two groups are more than 40 yards apart, so Healing Tide Totem only reaches your own group within 40 yards. Drop it next to your assigned group.

Vashnik the Malignant: [해제] Dispelling Exploding Infection makes Caustic Explosion hit the raid, so stagger with the other dispellers and clear one player at a time with Purify Spirit.
@m [생존기] Line up a Healing Tide Totem or Spirit Link Totem turn with Gloom Expulsion and Conflagrating Expulsion, which grow with each Imbibe.

The Lost Explorers: [차단] Join the interrupt rotation on Scrollsage Iku's Icebound Flames with Wind Shear.
[해제] Dispel an Icebound Flames that slips past interrupts with Purify Spirit.
[생존기] Line up Healing Tide Totem with the window when Frostfire Volley debuffs are being cleared.

Sszorak: [분담] Drop Spirit Link Totem where Mutilate is aimed at the raid and several players soak it, to even out health.
@m [분담] When 14 or more players stack within 8 yards of the Serpent's Fury target to take To the Slaughter, drop Spirit Link Totem on that spot.
[위치] When gathering in the middle before the Howling Maelstrom gusts, drop Wind Rush Totem for movement speed.

The Twin Fangs: [생존기] Line up Healing Tide Totem with the 6 sec of raid damage from Stir the Depths.
@m [차단] Join the interrupts on Broodling of Ithraz's Visceral Burst and Barbed Bulwark with Wind Shear.

The Coiled Altar: [차단] Once the Veil of Twilight shield breaks, join the Eternal Nightfall interrupt rotation with Wind Shear.
[분담] When 5 or more players stack within 9 yards of the Guillotine target, drop Spirit Link Totem, and when spreading, use Wind Rush Totem to get everyone past 40 yards quickly.
@hm [차단] Interrupt Spiteful Soulcoiler's Wail of Terror with Wind Shear.

Ula'tek: [해제] Drop Poison Cleansing Totem to clear the Acidic Burst poison DoT from Blightscale Viper off players within 30 yards one by one.
[차단] Interrupt Doomscale Warden's Malice in Phase 2 and Blightscale Shrieker's Vicious Echoes in Phase 3 with Wind Shear.
[생존기] Split Healing Tide Totem and Ascendance between the 20 sec of Rage of the Shackled raid damage and Fury Unleashed.

Nymrissa Wavecaller: [생존기] Take a Healing Tide Totem turn on Unending Tides.
[광역 피해] Pulsing Tides continues while a Bubblefin Berserker is alive, so drop Healing Stream Totem on cooldown.

Imperator Averzian: [분담] Drop Spirit Link Totem where the raid stacks to soak Umbral Collapse to reduce damage within 10 yards by 10% and even out health.
[생존기] Line up Healing Tide Totem with Dark Upheaval at the pull and after each intermission.
@m [해제] Abyssal Malus's Black Miasma is a Curse, so remove it with Purify Spirit, talented into Improved Purify Spirit.

Vorasius: [해제] The Blisterburst damage taken increase and the Creep Spit slow are Magic effects, so dispel them with Purify Spirit.
[회피] Once the Void Breath direction is set, drop Wind Rush Totem along the running path to raise raid movement speed by 40%.
@m [생존기] Line up Healing Tide Totem when the first Blistercreep pack pops.

Fallen-King Salhadaar: [생존기] Use Healing Tide Totem or Ascendance on the 20 sec of raid damage from Entropic Unraveling.
[참고] Strip the Oppressive Darkness healing absorb from players coming out of Despotic Command with Riptide and Healing Surge.
[차단] Interrupt Shadow Fracture from the nearest Fractured Image with Wind Shear or stun it with Capacitor Totem.

Vaelgor & Ezzorak: [해제] Dread Breath fear is a Magic effect, so dispel it right away with Purify Spirit.
[생존기] During Midnight Flames, drop Spirit Link Totem on the raid stacked inside Radiant Barrier to share the damage that gets through the absorb.
[차단] Interrupt Voidbolt from the Voidorb that spawns at your spot with Wind Shear.

Lightblinded Vanguard: [해제] The Avenger's Shield DoT is a Magic effect, so dispel it right away with Purify Spirit.
[참고] Using Bloodlust or Heroism makes the boss immune to damage for 8 sec with Divine Shield, so use it once the enemy buff dispeller is ready.
[분담] Focus heal players with the Tyr's Wrath healing absorb using Riptide and Chain Heal.

Crown of the Cosmos: [해제] Corrupting Essence on a player is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Purify Spirit.
[해제] Dispelling Null Corona with Purify Spirit moves the absorb to someone else, so heal through it with Healing Wave and only dispel in an emergency.
@nh [차단] Interrupt Undying Voidspawn's Void Barrage with Wind Shear, or drop Capacitor Totem where they are grouped to stun them.

Chimaerus the Undreamt God: [차단] Interrupt Haunting Essence's Fearsome Cry with Wind Shear. A fear that slips through is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Purify Spirit.
@hm [해제] Dispel Consuming Miasma with Purify Spirit once the target reaches an Alndust Essence pool.
[광역 피해] Strip the Rift Sickness healing absorb applied every time adds spawn from several players at once with Chain Heal and Healing Rain.

Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar: [광역 피해] Heal off the Light Burn and Void Burn healing absorbs completely with Riptide and Healing Surge.
[생존기] Bloodlust is used on the first egg phase, so time Bloodlust or Heroism with the start of Phase 2 Rebirth and use Healing Tide Totem with it.
[차단] Interrupt Light Eruption or Void Eruption from embers matching your feather color with Wind Shear.

Midnight Falls: [분담] Heal a Dusk Crystal to full with Riptide and Healing Wave to turn it into a Dawn Crystal.
@nh [해제] The stacking Safeguard buff is a Magic effect, so strip it with Purge, and interrupt the cast with Wind Shear.
@m [생존기] Bloodlust is used in Phase 3, so time Bloodlust or Heroism with the start of Phase 3.

Rotmire: @hm [해제] Poison Cleansing Totem clears a Poison Burst poison DoT that slips past interrupts off players within 30 yards every 1.5 sec.
@hm [차단] Interrupt Poison Burst from the Sporecaps near the boss with Wind Shear.
[생존기] Rotting Pustules makes damage ramp up as the fight goes on, so stack Healing Tide Totem and Ascendance late in the fight.

note: There is no spec-specific source for each raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching ability tooltips to boss mechanics.

notes: 독 해제는 Poison Cleansing Totem 기준
Healing Rain은 Totemic 영웅 특성에서 Surging Totem으로 바뀌어 제외, Ancestral Swiftness 등 영웅 한쪽 기술 제외
1시즌: 해제 줄은 digest 해제 목록(Magic·Curse·Poison)과 Purify Spirit·Improved Purify Spirit·Poison Cleansing Totem·Purge 툴팁을 짝지었다. Divine Shield는 해제 유형이 확인되지 않아 Purge 줄로 쓰지 않고 블러드 시점 참고로만 썼다.
1시즌: 블러드 줄은 s1.json 보스 블러드 칸(Belo'ren 2단계 첫 알, Midnight Falls 3단계)에 맞췄다. 영웅 특성 전용 기술은 쓰지 않았다.
